name: Ranger Dark Hunter
body:
The peoples of the dark warrens and world underground live among dangers far beyond surface dwellers ever encounter. As such many train hunters to track, scout, kill in those deep, dark places.

Improved Stonecunning (Ex)

The dark hunter gains stonecunning as the dwarven ancestral trait. If the dark hunter already has stonecunning, the bonus provided doubles.

This ability replaces wild empathy.

Stone Hue (Su)

At 1st level, he dark hunter taps into latent magical energies of the deep dark realms to aid in their stealth. They gain a bonus on Stealth checks equal to 1/2 their class level if they are within 5 feet of a stone or earth wall.

This ability replaces endurance.

Improved Darkvision (Ex)

At 3rd level, the dark hunter gains or improves their darkvision by 30 feet.

This distance increases by 30 feet at 8th, 13th, and 18th levels.

Underground Scout (Ex)

Beginning with 3rd level, the dark hunter must select underground as their favored terrain. The bonus to underground as their favored terrain increases by +2 at 8th, 13th, and 18th levels.

This ability modifies favored terrain.

Sneak Attack (Ex)

At 4th level, the dark hunter gains a 1d6 sneak attack as the rogue ability of the same name. This ability increases by 1d6 for every 3 levels thereafter.

This ability replaces hunter’s bond.
